A single uploaded workout video and the facts we record about it.

The bytes themselves live in object storage under ``storage_key``; this
model carries only verifiable metadata (hash, dimensions, duration) so the
pipeline can reason about the asset without touching the media.

get.description: Liveness probe used by Compose/CI; returns a static ok with no I/O.

Serve proxy, pose or timestamps to the signed owner; never original media.

Proxy supports one Range header (bytes=start-end, bytes=start-, or bytes=-suffix).
Pose/timestamp requests ignore Range and return the complete bounded artifact.

200.description: Private proxy, pose JSONL, or timestamp map; raw retention applies.

206.description: Single byte range of the private proxy video.

416.description: Malformed or unsatisfiable proxy byte range.

post.description:
Refresh evidence source drafts for a reference. FR11.

Returns DRAFT SourceRecords (never approved). SEARCH_PROVIDER selects the
provider: 'tavily' makes a bounded live call; anything else uses the cached
offline default so the route spends zero credits by default.
